title: Chapter 6487: This Has Nothing To Do With Me, Take Care

Chapter 6487: This Has Nothing To Do With Me, Take Care

Chapter 6487: This Has Nothing To Do With Me, Take Care

The primal ancestors in Old World seemed to have received a special pardon, spared from the stagnation.

Moreover, they came prepared and leaped into the air, sending out divine chains polished for eras from an immortal.

They pulsed wonderfully and wielded the ultimate power of tribulation. Their target was none other than the source of Paramount.

“Clank!” Four wrapped around the longevity spirit. It tried to escape but was immobilized by the woman’s song.

The attackers then revealed old mirrors on their chest. When pointed at the sky on the same spot, an immortal paradise appeared above them.

“Immortal Ascension Grand Formation!” They shouted in unison.

The light of this realm illuminated the longevity spirit, pushing it back to the source of Paramount.

“Boom!” It sealed the spirit in place and the four chains drilled into the source of Paramount, channeling the power of life into the primal ancestors.

Something similar happened in Paragon with Skyraiser, Nine-turns, and Eight-armed. Their chains pierced through the source of Paragon and coiled around its lord.

The latter roared and tried to stop the three chains but the music from the immortal artifact immobilized him. His paragon dao was nullified as well, rendering him helpless.

“Immortal Ascension Grand Formation!” The trio had mirrors and summoned the formation in the sky.

The mighty formation sealed all of Paragon, forcing the source and the lord to fuse as one. Next, the chains channeled paragon energy into the primal ancestors.

This happened in just a few seconds - the primal ancestors in Old World instantly took control of Paramount and Paragon.

Of course, a fool could tell this was planned with the night goddess in charge. The flute was essential in paralyzing the lord of Paragon and the spirit of Paramount. Otherwise, the primal ancestors would have been obliterated.

Once the channeling began, the woman stopped playing the flute. This wasn’t a choice since she had used all of her vitality and energy with that song.

She took out an immortal pill to replenish the depletion. Otherwise, she might fall to the ground.

When the song stopped, the stagnation also disappeared for everyone. Time flowed again and North Kun God saw the development with a soured expression.

He crossed the river without difficulty to reach the primal ancestors. However, Tenacious jumped out of the river, preparing to depart.

“Senior, why are you leaving?” The woman shouted.

“This has nothing to do with me. From today henceforth, God Frontier will close its doors, take care.” Tenacious answered without turning back and disappeared.

The woman was surprised to see this, the same for her allies. Tenacious has always been on their side, not to mention the agreement.

They had successfully taken control of the two major realms and could share the powers with him. Given his current cultivation and their influx, he might become a supreme overlord.

His decisiveness certainly caught everyone off guard. No one understood why he changed his mind. Only he knew he wanted to live and not linger here any longer.

He was aware of a certain someone’s presence, so he left while he still could. This meant the woman’s backer, a supreme overlord, was utterly ineffective here.

“Whoosh!” North Kun God approached Seventy-two Origin Ancestor and Trinity who were amazed at his speed.
